prompt: Using the attached photo as the identity reference, create a photorealistic, cinematic editorial portrait of this exact same person standing on a modern underground subway platform at night, in the style of a high-end street fashion photograph. Keep the exact same face, facial structure, skin tone, eye color, eyebrows, nose, lips, hairstyle, hair color, facial hair, glasses if present, age and body build as in the attached photo, so the person is instantly recognizable. Only the clothing, setting and photographic style change. Wardrobe adapts to the person: if male, a long black wool overcoat over a black turtleneck or crew-neck sweater, dark tailored trousers, clean minimal look. If female, a long black wool overcoat over a black fitted turtleneck, dark straight trousers, minimal jewelry, hair styled naturally. All clothing is opaque, closed and fully covering, with real wool texture, soft creases and a slightly turned-up collar. Pose and expression: standing near the platform edge, body turned about 30 degrees away from the camera, head turned back toward the lens, one hand relaxed in the coat pocket, the other hanging naturally. Calm, confident, slightly serious expression, direct eye contact with the camera, lips relaxed, chin slightly lowered. Three-quarter body framing from mid-thigh up, the person positioned on the right third of the frame. Setting: a clean modern subway station with a long concrete platform, dark grey tiled floor with a yellow tactile safety strip along the edge, dark walls, cool white ceiling strip lights receding into the distance on the left. Behind the person a subway train is passing at speed, rendered as a long-exposure motion blur: horizontal streaks of silver-grey metal and warm-lit windows, with a bright electric-blue LED light strip along the train body smearing into a glowing horizontal line. Wet reflections on the platform floor pick up the blue and warm light. Camera and light: shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at f/2.8, slow shutter around 1/8 second so the train is blurred while the person remains perfectly sharp and still, eye-level camera, slight low angle. Lighting is low-key: cool white overhead station light as key from above, blue rim light from the train streak on one side of the face and coat, warm amber fill from platform lamps on the other side. Deep soft shadows, natural skin texture with pores, crisp catchlights in the eyes. Style: cinematic night editorial, high contrast with rich blacks, subtle film grain, palette of 60% deep charcoal and black, 30% cool steel-blue and electric-blue light, 10% warm amber accents. Looks like a real photograph from a fashion campaign shot on location in a metro station.

promptZh: 以附图作为身份参考，创作一张照片级真实、电影感的时尚人像，展现同一个人站在现代地下地铁站台上的场景，风格为高端街头时尚摄影。保持与附图完全一致的脸型、面部结构、肤色、眼色、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇、发型、发色、胡须、眼镜（如有）、年龄和体型，确保人物具有极高的辨识度。仅改变服装、背景和摄影风格。服装适配：若为男性，身穿黑色长款羊毛大衣，内搭黑色高领或圆领毛衣，深色修身长裤，风格简洁极简。若为女性，身穿黑色长款羊毛大衣，内搭黑色修身高领衫，深色直筒长裤，佩戴极简首饰，发型自然。所有服装均为不透明、闭合且完全覆盖，具有真实的羊毛质感、柔和的褶皱和微立的领口。姿势与表情：站在站台边缘附近，身体背对镜头约 30 度，头部转向镜头，一只手自然插在口袋里，另一只手自然下垂。表情冷静、自信、略显严肃，直视镜头，双唇放松，下巴微收。采用大腿中部以上的四分之三身位构图，人物位于画面的右三分之一处。环境：干净的现代地铁站，拥有长长的混凝土站台，深灰色瓷砖地面，边缘带有黄色触觉安全条，墙壁深色，左侧冷白色天花板灯带向远处延伸。人物身后有一列地铁高速驶过，呈现为长曝光下的动态模糊效果：银灰色金属和暖色车窗形成的水平条纹，车身上的亮电蓝色 LED 灯带拖曳成发光的水平线。站台地面上的湿润倒影映衬出蓝色和暖色光芒。相机与灯光：使用全画幅相机搭配 35mm 镜头，光圈 f/2.8，快门速度约 1/8 秒，使列车产生模糊，而人物保持清晰静止，平视拍摄，略带低角度。灯光为低调摄影风格：以头顶的冷白色车站灯光作为主光，一侧脸部和外套边缘带有来自列车光影的蓝色轮廓光，另一侧由站台灯光提供暖琥珀色补光。深邃柔和的阴影，展现带有毛孔的自然皮肤质感，眼中带有清澈的眼神光。风格：电影感夜间时尚大片，高对比度，深黑色调丰富，带有细微的胶片颗粒感，色调比例为 60% 深炭黑，30% 冷钢蓝色与电蓝色光，10% 暖琥珀色点缀。看起来就像是在地铁站实地拍摄的真实时尚广告大片。
